text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that the steering committee meets bi-weekly.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"The steering committee meets bi-weekly to review project status, budget utilization, and risk items."}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document does not state a meeting frequency for the steering committee; it only says a quarterly review of success metrics will be conducted by the committee.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s6","quote":"A quarterly review will be conducted by the steering committee to track progress against these metrics."}]},{"text":"The documents therefore do not give conflicting meeting frequencies: one states bi-weekly meetings, and the other mentions only a quarterly metrics review, which is not stated as the committee's meeting schedule.","kind":"framing","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
